brief.summary_1line: Flying in the Pushpaka chariot, Rama points out battle sites, sacred places, and memories to Sita while traveling from Lanka toward Kishkindha and Ayodhya.

image_candidates.scene_text: The radiant Pushpaka chariot drawn by swans glides over Lanka as Rama gestures below while Sita looks down at the blood-soaked battlefield.
From the sky, Rama shows Sita the long stone bridge stretching across the roaring ocean toward Lanka.
The aerial chariot pauses above Kishkindha as Tara and the adorned monkey women board to accompany Sita to Ayodhya.
